provenance: Three pre-registered studies: 730 scored cells across six models (October 2026), each registered by commit before its first scored run (hypotheses, corpora, and graders all committed first) and published as found, gate letters included. Study 1's fixture is 16 hand-authored chord progressions (440 bars, known chords by construction) rendered by deterministic synthesis and transcribed by Spotify Basic Pitch with the production app's exact model files and thresholds; Study 2's system under test is the production Text-to-Beat call ported verbatim and pinned by test; Study 3 engraves hand-authored MusicXML through Verovio and grades the model's reading against production's own summary of the source, a full round trip with every fact known by construction. Every call shape matches production, with registered amendments where a first run produced no scorable cells, a registered re-run after the app adopted Study 1's matcher fix, and two disclosed fixture amendments before Study 3's matrix.
footer: Pre-registered briefs, the corpus, the synthesis and grading code, and all analyses live in the stem-bench repository (BRIEF.md, REPORT.md). The product under test is Stem Shovel, Lightning Jar's music collaboration app. Sibling programs: AEO Bench and Barkup Bench.
